summary: Composable target-selection functions: lowest health, highest health, random.
overview: Plain static selection logic, in the same spirit as the steering and easing helpers. Each returns null when the candidate list is empty or everyone in it is dead, so a caller has one case to handle rather than several.
useCases: An enemy that finishes off the weakest target.
A healer picking whoever most needs it.
Random targeting for an unpredictable boss.

gotchas.title: Null means "nobody valid", not an error
gotchas.body: An empty list and a list of corpses both return null. Treat it as the normal end-of-battle case.
